gcm.purpose: Add a lightweight Handle Now path so small immediate Gmail actions can be completed without inventing Work or AI routing rules.
changeNotes: Updates the Morning Command Gmail decision surface to 2.1.0.
Adds Handle Now, which leaves Gmail and GCM OS unchanged while the operator completes the action.
Adds explicit completion that clears Gmail with zero OS records, while preserving all existing human routing boundaries.
Adds permanent regression coverage for the immediate-action boundary.
